ratio_contact_default.title: Contact Us
ratio_contact_default.subtitle: Have a question about an order, a product, or anything else? Reach out — we'd love to hear from you.

sections.heading: Customer Support
sections.body: For questions about orders, shipping, returns, or products, email us or call during our support hours. We aim to respond to all enquiries within one business day.

sections.heading: Order Enquiries
sections.body: Please have your order number ready when you contact us so we can assist you as quickly as possible.

sections.heading: Wholesale & Partnerships
sections.body: Interested in stocking our products or partnering with us? Get in touch using the email above and our team will follow up.
